notes.title: Crystal Crisis Update! Cross-Play and Spectator Mode
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35404439/d988317f17afdfcba8b3ae2a42f0048555c3e922.png[/img]

Attention, puzzle combat fans: Crystal Crisis has been updated to enable cross-play with the Nintendo Switch and Epic Games Store versions of the game, increasing the number of potential opponents when you join online battles. Once you've downloaded the update, just search for a player in any online game mode and the game will automatically search for players across all three platforms.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35404439/047259d9462a67f5f0e76663f86918cbead36cf7.png[/img]

But that's not all! The update also adds a new Spectator Mode for watching online matches between other players, also on all three platforms. Choose "Go Online" from the main menu, then select "Spectate" and you can choose which type of match you'd like to watch. The best Crystal Crisis players play online, so you might be able to pick up some pointers if you need the help!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35404439/364e35296f14ab8efe7df45a17c18273c8948629.png[/img]

Looking for more friends to play Crystal Crisis with? Join the official Discord at https://discord.gg/ucsvqfw

Thanks for your continued support. Please enjoy this new update!
